#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, b;
    cin >> n >> b;

    vector<int> arr(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> arr[i];
    }

    vector<int> costs;
    int odd = 0, even = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (arr[i] % 2 == 0) {
            ++even;
        } else {
            ++odd;
        }

        if (odd == even && i != n - 1) {
            costs.push_back(abs(arr[i + 1] - arr[i]));
            odd = 0;
            even = 0;
        }
    }

    sort(costs.begin(), costs.end());

    int sum = 0;
    int cut = 0;

    for (int amount : costs) {
        sum += amount;
        if (sum > b) {
            break;
        }
        ++cut;
    }

    cout << cut << endl;

    return 0;
}
